pages.title: Finding Shadow Iron
pages.text: Default deposits: Nether, Y 96 to 32. Veins target up to 7 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 3.

pages.title: Working Shadow Iron
pages.text: Smelt Shadow Iron Ore or Shadow Iron Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 118 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 6.4.$(br)Material damage bonus: 5.9.$(br)Enchantability: 9.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 9.

pages.title: Pickaxe: Incompatible
pages.text: Mining Shadow Iron ore will sometimes drop a different ore.

pages.title: Weapon: Chaos Crit
pages.text: Attacks occasionally become critical hits dealing random increased damage up to more than 3 times the base attack value.

pages.title: Armor: Broken Evasion
pages.text: Has a chance of absorbing attack damage completely at the cost of durability from one of the armor pieces
